case: A guard is removed from the edge that calls it. The guard definition is untouched, byte for byte, and every conjunct pin over it still passes.
why: The review swept this: one detachment fixture per guard, every call site removed, thirty runs, THIRTY UNDETECTED AND ZERO CAUGHT. This is the sharpest instance. `guard.class.no_total_rank` detached from `edge.ConsequenceDerivation.computed.recomputed_at_release.v1` restores AT-M4-02 -- the derivation may declare an ordering, a rank returns, and C2's human requirement is dropped on an action that is both C2 and C3 -- and it also removes the `unique` on reached_class_ids that keeps the sibling gate check on the same edge honest. A conjunct pin holds a guard to what its BODY demands and says nothing about whether any edge calls it; pinned_attachments is the half that does.
